<translated_code>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <algorithm>

class Test {
public:
    long long R, C;
    std::vector<std::vector<long long>> ch;
    std::vector<int> cntA, cntB;
    long long best;
    std::string str;
    std::unordered_map<long long, long long> memo;
    std::unordered_set<long long> tried;

    static int readInt() {
        int ans = 0;
        bool neg = false;
        bool start = false;
        int c;
        while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
            if (c == '-') { start = true; neg = true; continue; }
            if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { start = true; ans = ans * 10 + (c - '0'); }
            else if (start) break;
        }
        return neg ? -ans : ans;
    }

    static long long readLong() {
        long long ans = 0;
        bool neg = false;
        bool start = false;
        int c;
        while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
            if (c == '-') { start = true; neg = true; continue; }
            if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { start = true; ans = ans * 10 + (c - '0'); }
            else if (start) break;
        }
        return neg ? -ans : ans;
    }

    static std::string readString() {
        std::string s;
        bool start = false;
        int c;
        while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
            if (!isspace(c)) { start = true; s.push_back((char)c); }
            else if (start) break;
        }
        return s;
    }

    static int readChars(char* a, int off) {
        int cnt = 0;
        bool start = false;
        int c;
        while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
            if (isalnum(c)) { start = true; a[off + cnt++] = (char)c; }
            else if (start) break;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long diff = llabs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) { if (diff < best) best = diff; return; }
        long long key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        if (tried.find(key) != tried.end()) return;
        if (v1 >= R) {
            long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v2][R];
            dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= R) {
            long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v1][R];
            dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        tried.insert(key);
    }

    long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long diff = llabs(x - y);
        if (diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best) return 0;
        long long key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        auto it = memo.find(key);
        if (it != memo.end()) return it->second;
        if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
            if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
                int sum = v1 + v2;
                v1 -= cntA[sum];
                v2 -= cntB[sum];
                return ch[v1 + v2][v1];
            }
            return 0;
        }
        long long ans = 0;
        char c = str[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (c != 'B') {
            long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v2][R];
            ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (c != 'A') {
            long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v1][R];
            ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        memo[key] = ans;
        return ans;
    }

    void solve() {
        R = readInt();
        C = readInt();
        int maxN = 2 * (R + C);
        ch.assign(maxN + 1, std::vector<long long>(maxN + 1, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; i++) {
            ch[i][0] = ch[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++)
                ch[i][j] = ch[i - 1][j - 1] + ch[i - 1][j];
        }
        long long x = 0, y = 0;
        int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
        while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R) {
            if (x > y) {
                long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
                long long other = ch[v2][R];
                y += cur * other;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
                long long other = ch[v1][R];
                x += cur * other;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        best = llabs(x - y);
        dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        str = readString();
        int strLen = 2 * (R + C);
        cntA.assign(strLen + 1, 0);
        cntB.assign(strLen + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < strLen; i++) {
            cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (str[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (str[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        long long ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
        fflush(stdout);
    }
};

int main() {
    Test t;
    t.solve();
    return 0;
}
